name: ATHENA Pallas
description: The ATHENA Pallas is a luxury boutique hotel with a collection of 56 uniquely appointed suites, apartments & rooms, ATHENA Pallas perfectly infuses a blend of old world feel & aristic bohemia. ATHENA Pallas is situated in the center of Athens Historical center on the storied Athinas street. The Hotel is just moments away from Monastiraki, Plaka & the Acropolis neighborhod. A place with memory, with facile connections to discover the best of everything the acient city has to offer. From the vibrant shops & food market, to famous bars & restaurants, galleries and museums.
